flora.name: Dandelion
flora.identification: Yellow flower head, lobed leaves form a rosette at base, hollow milky stem.
flora.uses: Leaves in salad, roots roasted for tea, flowers for jelly.
flora.caution: Ensure area hasn't been sprayed with pesticides.

flora.name: Stinging Nettle
flora.identification: Serrated leaves, tiny stinging hairs on stems and leaves.
flora.caution: Must be cooked or dried to disarm stinging hairs. Wear gloves when harvesting.

flora.name: Hemlock
flora.identification: Purple blotches on smooth stems, fern-like leaves, white umbrella flowers.
flora.caution: Easily confused with Queen Anne's Lace or Wild Carrot. Do not touch.

fauna.name: Honey Bee
fauna.notes: Essential for garden health. Attracted to purple and blue flowers.

fauna.name: Ladybug
fauna.notes: Eats aphids and other garden pests.

fauna.name: Tomato Hornworm
fauna.notes: Large green caterpillar with horn on tail. Strips tomato plants quickly.
